title: The Largest Natural Hot Springs on Earth!

scenes.query: aerial view of Grand Prismatic Spring
scenes.text: This hot spring is truly gigantic!

scenes.query: Grand Prismatic Spring aerial view showcasing the size of the spring
scenes.text: It measures 370 feet wide and is 121 feet deep.

scenes.query: Grand Prismatic Spring close-up of colorful bacteria in hot spring
scenes.text: Its unique colors come from bacterial mats and mineral-rich water.

scenes.query: Grand Prismatic Spring panoramic view of Yellowstone National Park
scenes.text: It's part of the world's first national park!

scenes.query: Grand Prismatic Spring engaging visuals of Yellowstone National Park
scenes.text: Follow if you love to travel from your screen.

description: Discover the breathtaking Grand Prismatic Spring, the largest natural hot spring in the world, located in Yellowstone National Park. Join us for more stunning locations!
